title_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Tek Mei's Garden, Ish-Fusha Aviacionit shitet apartament 2+1+2 me planimetri te rregullt. Prona ndodhet ne katin 4 si dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 102.34 m2, nga ku 86.21 m2 eshte siperfaqe neto. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete si dhe ballkoni. Aktualisht ndertimi ndodhet ne faze karabinaje. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: At Mei's Garden, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Regular Layout!!!
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment with regular floor plan is for sale at Mei's Garden, Former Aviation Field. The property is located on the 4th floor and has a total area of ​​102.34 m2, of which 86.21 m2 is the net area. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Currently, the construction is in the carabiner phase. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
